trap.label: as ... as
trap.wrong: He is so tall as me.
trap.right: He is as tall as me.
trap.why: Em português 'tão alto quanto/como' mistura palavras; em inglês é as ... as.

mcq.q: This is not ___ big as that.

fix.wrong: It is more expensive that mine.
fix.right: It is more expensive than mine.

fix.wrong: He is so fast as me.
fix.right: He is as fast as me.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com as ... as: “He is tall. I am tall.”
rewrite.answer: He is as tall as me.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “This is as big as that.”
rewrite.answer: This isn't as big as that.
